segments.contextBefore: The following example uses the cases of a `LoginForm` enumeration to bind the focus state of two `TextField` views.

segments.normalizedSource: ```None struct LoginForm { enum Field: Hashable { case usernameField case passwordField } @State private var username = "" @State private var password = "" @FocusState private var focusedField: Field? var body: some View { Form { TextField("Username", text: $username) .focused($focusedField, equals: .usernameField) SecureField("Password", text: $password) .focused($focusedField, equals: .passwordField) Button("Sign In") { if username.isEmpty { focusedField = .usernameField } else if password.isEmpty { focusedField = .passwordField } else { handleLogin(username, password) } } } } } ```
